judgment.reasoning_summary: The problem involves a point P moving along a circle in the complex plane, which can be represented by a complex number of the form 3e^(iθ). When P is rotated by an angle θ, the new position is given by 3e^(i(θ + θ)) = 3e^(i(2θ)). For θ = π/6, the new position is 3e^(i(π/3)).
